description: Source code for utility functions related to process management, system commands, and system info in the WanManager component.

methods.name: freeArgs
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for argument vector.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command and arguments into an argument vector.

methods.name: strtol64
methods.description: Converts string to 64-bit integer with error checking.

methods.name: util_spawnProcess
methods.description: Spawns a new process with given executable and arguments.

methods.name: util_signalProcess
methods.description: Sends a signal to a process by PID.

methods.name: util_getNameByPid
methods.description: Retrieves process name by PID.

methods.name: find_strstr
methods.description: Finds substring within a base string, even with null characters.

methods.name: util_getPidByName
methods.description: Finds PID of a process by name and optional args.

methods.name: util_collectProcess
methods.description: Waits for process termination with timeout.

methods.name: util_runCommandInShell
methods.description: Runs a command in a shell asynchronously.

methods.name: util_runCommandInShellBlocking
methods.description: Runs a command in a shell synchronously, waiting for completion.

methods.name: util_isFilePresent
methods.description: Checks if a file exists.

methods.name: GetRunTimeRootDir
methods.description: Gets the root directory for runtime.

methods.name: GetPathToApp
methods.description: Finds the full path to an application based on environment PATH.

methods.name: WanManager_DoSystemActionWithStatus
methods.description: Executes a system command and logs.

methods.name: WanManager_DoSystemAction
methods.description: Executes a system command with error logging.

methods.name: WanMgr_IsPIDRunning
methods.description: Checks if a process with given PID is running.

methods.name: WanManager_IsApplicationRunning
methods.description: Checks if an application is running by name.

methods.name: LaunchApp
methods.description: Launches an application by path and args.

methods.name: CollectApp
methods.description: Attempts to terminate and clean up a process by PID.

methods.name: WanManager_DoStartApp
methods.description: Starts an application by name and args.

methods.name: WanManager_DoStopApp
methods.description: Stops an application by name.

methods.name: WanManager_DoRestartApp
methods.description: Restarts an application by name and args.

methods.name: WanManager_StartIpoeHealthCheckService
methods.description: Starts IPoE health check service for a given interface.

methods.name: WanManager_StopIpoeHealthCheckService
methods.description: Stops IPoE health check service by PID.

methods.name: WanManager_GetDateAndUptime
methods.description: Retrieves current date/time and system uptime.

methods.name: WanManager_getUpTime
methods.description: Returns system uptime.

methods.name: WanManager_Util_GetShell_output
methods.description: Reads output from a shell command.

methods.name: WanMgr_RestartUpdateCfg
methods.description: Reads configuration value from restart info file.

methods.name: WanMgr_SetRestartWanInfo
methods.description: Sets restart info key-value in file.

methods.name: WanMgr_RestartUpdateCfg_Bool
methods.description: Reads boolean config value from restart info file.

methods.name: sysctl_iface_set
methods.description: Sets interface sysctl parameter.
